title: Eyes Full of Wonder
desc: You began taking in the world around you with those bright, curious eyes, pausing on lights, faces, and shadows as if everything deserved a closer look. Watching you notice things for the first time made the ordinary feel completely new again.
story: You were lying in my arms when I noticed your eyes moving slowly and deliberately across the ceiling, tracing the edge of the light like it was the most fascinating thing you had ever encountered. You would pause, really pause, on certain things, a shadow on the wall, the contrast of the window frame, my face when I leaned in close. It was so quiet and still, just you and your eyes doing all the work, drinking everything in with this calm, serious curiosity. I found myself following your gaze around the room, trying to see what you were seeing, and for a moment the whole world looked a little more worth looking at.
